title: output_revision-v1
description: A revision of one Event Sherpa plan: the change, the operations that make plan revision N+1 out of revision N, the conflicts a person decides and the items of other plans the change touches. tools/apply_revision.py composes the whole plan from it.

target.description: The plan revision this revision changes: output.output_id and output.revision of the current plan.

change_id.description: the id the caller gave the change, else chg- with the next revision number

request.description: the change in the organizer's words, or the impact it comes from

source.description: turn, tool result or skill the change came from

item.description: collection/id for an item addressed by id (programme/b03), else the dotted path of a section (concept, open_items, settings).

fields.description: set: the fields that change, each with its whole new value; null for the other ops.

value.description: add: the whole new item, its id equal to the one in item; replace: the whole new value of the section; null for the other ops.

after.description: add: the id the new item goes after, null to append it at the end; move: the id the item goes after, null for the start of the collection; null for the other ops.

item.description: collection/id for an item addressed by id (programme/b03), else the dotted path of a section (concept, open_items, settings).

fields.description: set: the fields that change, each with its whole new value; null for the other ops.

value.description: add: the whole new item, its id equal to the one in item; replace: the whole new value of the section; null for the other ops.

after.description: add: the id the new item goes after, null to append it at the end; move: the id the item goes after, null for the start of the collection; null for the other ops.

held_ops.description: operations that wait until a person picks an option; not applied

scope.description: whose plan the item is in when two skills share the contract: for microsite_app_plan-v1 microsite (Web Designer) or app (App Designer), whose plans can reuse the same ids; null or left out for the other plans

ref.description: id of the touched item in that plan
